title: How did it go?
_note: Retro, looking back. Two columns; reused by QBR with its own wording.

boxes.label: Went well
boxes.hint: What worked, and why did it work?

boxes.label: Got in the way
boxes.hint: What slowed us down or tripped us up?

slide.prompt: Fill both columns: one thing per line. Short is fine.
notes: Ask everyone to write before anyone talks: quiet writing first gets more voices onto the sheet.
If a column stays empty, ask: what would you want to keep doing? What would you rather never do again?
